pcm.title: Spirit Wey Dey Win
pcm.scriptureText: For midnight, Paul and Silas dey pray and sing praise to God, and the other prisoners dey listen to dem.
pcm.content:
Dem don beat Paul and Silas and lock dem inside the inner prison. The praise wey dem sing for midnight no mean say dem deny their wounds. Na how dem show say dem still stand with God for the place wey dem wan use silence dem. The other prisoners hear their prayers and songs. You no dey measure spirit wey dey win by how person dey smile when life easy; you dey see am when suffering no fit stop believer from turning to the Lord.

God shake the prison and open the doors, but the story no end with escape. Paul and Silas stay there, and dem stop the prison guard from harming himself. Dem tell am about Jesus, and everybody for im household hear the good news (Acts 16:26–34). Their freedom become chance to protect another person life and testify about God. This passage no promise say every prison door go open according to our own timetable. But e show say God dey with us for the night, and im people fit respond with prayer, praise, wisdom and compassion.

Wetin don feel like midnight for your life? Tell God the truth about the pain. Praise am for who e be, even if your voice dey shake, and ask am for strength to remain faithful where you dey. Look the people wey dey hear or see how you respond too. Maybe somebody need word of hope, practical care, or the good news itself. The Lord fit sustain your testimony for hard place; your suffering no need get the final say over your obedience.

You Need Prayer or Counselling? If you dey pass through season of pain or unfair treatment, share your request through Prayer / Counselling. Sign in with your email so our team fit reply and follow you up more easily. We go count am as honour to pray with you and support you.
prayerPoints: Father, meet me for the place where pain and confinement don make hope difficult. In Jesus name. Amen.
Lord, break the hopelessness wey dey tell me say prayer no get use for midnight. In Jesus name. Amen.
Holy Spirit, give me strength to worship sincerely, without pretending say my wounds no dey. In Jesus name. Amen.
Father, intervene where unfair treatment don trap or silence your people. In Jesus name. Amen.
Lord, protect me from bitterness, so the way I respond to suffering no go wound other people. In Jesus name. Amen.
Holy Spirit, help me notice person wey im life or hope need protection today. In Jesus name. Amen.
Father, make my endurance and compassion open door for the good news of Christ. In Jesus name. Amen.
faithDeclarations: The Lord dey hear me for midnight.
I fit pray and praise am without denying say the pain real.
My suffering no go decide whether I obey Christ or care for other people.
God presence fit sustain faithful testimony anywhere I dey.
pcm.christianQuotes: “Victory for midnight na heart wey still dey turn to God and still get space to care for another person life.” — Moses Afolabi
pcm.propheticDeclaration: Make the Lord sustain you through every night wey don feel long and unfair. I speak courage to pray, strength to praise, and wisdom to recognise the people wey need your care. Make God open way where you no fit see any, and make your faithful testimony point people to the hope of salvation in Jesus. In im name. Amen.

ha.title: Ruhun Nasara
ha.scriptureText: Da tsakar dare, Bulus da Sila suna addu’a suna rera waƙoƙin yabon Allah, sauran fursunoni kuma suna sauraronsu.
ha.content:
An yi wa Bulus da Sila dūka, aka kulle su a cikin kurkuku na ciki. Yabonsu da tsakar dare ba ya nufin sun musanta raunukansu. Hanya ce ta nuna amincinsu ga Allah a wurin da aka nufa a rufe musu baki. Sauran fursunoni sun ji addu’o’insu da waƙoƙinsu. Ba a auna ruhun nasara da fara’a lokacin da rayuwa take da sauƙi; ana ganinsa sa’ad da wahala ba ta iya hana mai bi juyowa ga Ubangiji.

Allah ya girgiza kurkukun, ya buɗe ƙofofin, amma labarin bai ƙare da guduwa ba. Bulus da Sila sun zauna, suka hana mai gadin kurkuku cutar da kansa. Sun gaya masa labarin Yesu, kuma mutanen gidansa suka ji bishara (Acts 16:26–34). ’Yancinsu ya zama damar kare ran wani da kuma ba da shaida. Wannan nassi bai yi alkawarin cewa kowace ƙofar kurkuku za ta buɗe bisa jadawalinmu ba. Amma yana nuna cewa Allah yana nan cikin dare, kuma mutanensa za su iya amsawa da addu’a, yabo, hikima da tausayi.

Me ya zama kamar tsakar dare a gare ka? Faɗa wa Allah gaskiyar zafin da kake ji. Yabe shi saboda wanda yake, ko da muryarka tana rawa, ka roƙe shi ƙarfin yin abin da ya dace cikin aminci a inda kake. Ka kuma lura da mutanen da suke ji ko ganin yadda kake amsawa. Wataƙila wani yana bukatar kalmar bege, taimako na zahiri, ko bishara kanta. Ubangiji zai iya ƙarfafa shaidarka a wuri mai wuya; ba dole ba ne wahalarka ta zama ita ce mai yanke hukunci na ƙarshe a kan biyayyarka.

Kana Bukatar Addu’a ko Shawara? Idan kana cikin yanayi mai zafi ko rashin adalci, ka tura buƙatarka ta ɓangaren Addu’a / Shawara. Ka shiga da adireshin imel ɗinka domin ƙungiyarmu ta iya amsawa da kuma ci gaba da kula da kai cikin sauƙi. Zai zama abin daraja a gare mu mu yi addu’a tare da kai, mu kuma tallafa maka.
prayerPoints: Ya Uba, ka same ni a wurin da zafi da ƙuntatawa suka sa bege ya yi wuya. Cikin sunan Yesu. Amin.
Ya Ubangiji, ka karya fid da zuciyar da take gaya mini cewa addu’a ba ta da amfani da tsakar dare. Cikin sunan Yesu. Amin.
Ya Ruhu Mai Tsarki, ka ba ni ƙarfin yin sujada da gaskiya, ba tare da yin kamar ba ni da raunuka ba. Cikin sunan Yesu. Amin.
Ya Uba, ka sa baki a inda rashin adalci ya kama mutanenka ko ya rufe musu baki. Cikin sunan Yesu. Amin.
Ya Ubangiji, ka tsare ni daga ɗacin rai, domin yadda nake amsa wahala kada ya raunata wasu. Cikin sunan Yesu. Amin.
Ya Ruhu Mai Tsarki, ka sa in lura da mutumin da ransa ko begensa yake bukatar kariya a yau. Cikin sunan Yesu. Amin.
Ya Uba, ka sa jimiri da tausayina su buɗe ƙofa ga bisharar Almasihu. Cikin sunan Yesu. Amin.
faithDeclarations: Ubangiji yana ji na da tsakar dare.
Zan iya yin addu’a in kuma yabe shi, ba tare da musanta cewa zafin da nake ji na gaske ne ba.
Wahalata ba za ta yanke shawarar ko zan yi wa Almasihu biyayya ko in kula da wasu ba.
Kasancewar Allah tare da ni za ta iya ƙarfafa shaida mai aminci a duk inda nake.
ha.christianQuotes: “Nasara da tsakar dare ita ce zuciyar da take ci gaba da juyowa ga Allah, kuma har yanzu tana da sararin kula da ran wani.” — Moses Afolabi
ha.propheticDeclaration: Bari Ubangiji ya ƙarfafa ka a kowane dare da ya yi maka tsawo, kuma ya zama kamar ana yi maka rashin adalci. Ina furta ƙarfin zuciyar yin addu’a, ƙarfin yin yabo, da hikimar gane mutanen da suke bukatar kulawarka. Bari Allah ya yi hanya a inda ba ka ganin hanya, ya kuma sa shaidarka mai aminci ta nufi begen ceton da yake cikin Yesu. Cikin sunansa. Amin.

ig.title: Mmụọ Mmeri
ig.scriptureText: Nʼetiti abalị, mgbe Pọl na Saịlas na-ekpe ekpere na-abụkwa abụ ito Chineke, ndị niile nọ nʼụlọ mkpọrọ ahụ na-ege ha ntị.
ig.content:
A kụwo Pọl na Saịlas ihe, kpọchie ha n’ime ụlọ mkpọrọ dị n’ime. Otuto ha n’etiti abalị apụtaghị na ha na-agọnahụ ọnyá ha. Ọ bụ ụzọ ha si gosipụta iguzosi ike n’ihe nye Chineke n’ebe a chọrọ ime ka ha mechie ọnụ. Ndị mkpọrọ ndị ọzọ nụrụ ekpere ha na abụ ha. A naghị atụ mmụọ mmeri site n’ihu ọchị mgbe ndụ dị mfe; a na-ahụ ya mgbe ahụhụ enweghị ike igbochi onye kwere ekwe ịtụgharịkwuru Onyenwe anyị.

Chineke mere ka ụlọ mkpọrọ ahụ maa jijiji, meghee ọnụ ụzọ ya, ma akụkọ ahụ akwụsịghị n’ịgbapụ. Pọl na Saịlas nọrọ ebe ahụ, gbochie onye nche ụlọ mkpọrọ imerụ onwe ya ahụ. Ha gwara ya banyere Jizọs, ndị ụlọ ya wee nụ oziọma (Acts 16:26–34). Nnwere onwe ha ghọrọ ohere ichebe ndụ onye ọzọ na ịgba ama. Amaokwu a anaghị ekwe nkwa na ọnụ ụzọ ụlọ mkpọrọ ọ bụla ga-emeghe n’oge anyị họọrọ. Ma ọ na-egosi na Chineke nọ ya n’abalị, nakwa na ndị ya nwere ike iji ekpere, otuto, amamihe na ọmịiko zaghachi.

Gịnị dị ka etiti abalị nye gị? Gwa Chineke eziokwu banyere ihe mgbu ahụ. Too ya n’ihi onye ọ bụ, ọ bụrụgodị na olu gị na-ama jijiji, rịọkwa ya ike ime ihe kwesịrị ekwesị n’ikwesị ntụkwasị obi n’ebe ị nọ. Leekwa ndị na-anụ ma ọ bụ na-ahụ otú i si azaghachi. Ikekwe mmadụ chọrọ okwu olileanya, nlekọta e gosipụtara n’omume, ma ọ bụ oziọma n’onwe ya. Onyenwe anyị nwere ike ịkwagide ịgba ama gị n’ọnọdụ siri ike; ahụhụ gị ekwesịghị inwe okwu ikpeazụ banyere nrubeisi gị.

Ị Chọrọ Ekpere ma ọ bụ Ndụmọdụ? Ọ bụrụ na ị nọ n’oge ihe mgbu ma ọ bụ mmegbu na-ezighị ezi, zipụ arịrịọ gị site na Ekpere / Ndụmọdụ. Jiri adreesị ozi ịntanetị gị banye ka ndị otu anyị nwee ike ịza gị ma na-esochikwa gị n’ụzọ dị mfe. Ọ ga-abụrụ anyị ihe ùgwù ikpere gị ekpere na inye gị nkwado.
prayerPoints: Nna, zute m n’ebe ihe mgbu na mkpọchi mere ka olileanya sie ike. N’aha Jizọs. Amen.
Onyenwe anyị, kwatuo enweghị olileanya nke na-agwa m na ekpere abaghị uru n’etiti abalị. N’aha Jizọs. Amen.
Mmụọ Nsọ, nye m ike ife gị ofufe n’eziokwu, n’emeghị ka a ga-asị na ọnyá m adịghị. N’aha Jizọs. Amen.
Nna, tinye aka n’ebe mmegbu na-ezighị ezi tọrọ ndị gị n’ọnyà ma ọ bụ mee ka ha mechie ọnụ. N’aha Jizọs. Amen.
Onyenwe anyị, chebe m pụọ n’obi ilu, ka otú m si azaghachi ahụhụ ghara imerụ ndị ọzọ ahụ. N’aha Jizọs. Amen.
Mmụọ Nsọ, nyere m aka ịṅa ntị n’onye ndụ ya ma ọ bụ olileanya ya chọrọ nchebe taa. N’aha Jizọs. Amen.
Nna, ka ntachi obi m na ọmịiko m meghee ụzọ maka oziọma Kraịst. N’aha Jizọs. Amen.
faithDeclarations: Onyenwe anyị na-anụ m n’etiti abalị.
Enwere m ike ikpe ekpere na ito ya, n’agọnahụghị na ihe mgbu m bụ eziokwu.
Ahụhụ m agaghị ekpebi ma m ga-erubere Kraịst isi ma ọ bụ lekọta ndị ọzọ.
Ọnụnọ Chineke nwere ike ịkwagide ịgba ama kwesịrị ntụkwasị obi n’ebe ọ bụla m nọ.
ig.christianQuotes: “Mmeri n’etiti abalị bụ obi nke na-anọgide na-atụgharịkwuru Chineke ma ka nwee ohere ilekọta ndụ onye ọzọ.” — Moses Afolabi
ig.propheticDeclaration: Ka Onyenwe anyị kwagide gị n’abalị ọ bụla nke dị gị ogologo ma jupụta n’ihe na-ezighị ezi. Ana m ekwu obi ike ikpe ekpere, ike ito Chineke, na amamihe ịmata ndị chọrọ nlekọta gị. Ka Chineke mepụta ụzọ n’ebe ị na-enweghị ike ịhụ ụzọ, meekwa ka ịgba ama gị kwesịrị ntụkwasị obi duzie ndị mmadụ n’olileanya nzọpụta dị na Jizọs. N’aha ya. Amen.

yo.title: Ẹ̀mí Ìṣẹ́gun
yo.scriptureText: Ṣùgbọ́n láàrín ọ̀gànjọ́ Paulu àti Sila ń gbàdúrà, wọ́n sì ń kọrin ìyìn si Ọlọ́run, àwọn ara túbú sì ń tẹ́tí sí wọn.
yo.content:
A ti lu Paulu àti Sila, a sì ti tì wọ́n mọ́ yàrá tí ó wà ní apá inú ẹ̀wọ̀n. Ìyìn wọn ní ọ̀gànjọ́ kò túmọ̀ sí pé wọ́n sẹ́ pé àwọn ní ọgbẹ́. Ó jẹ́ ọ̀nà tí wọ́n fi fi ìṣòtítọ́ wọn hàn sí Ọlọ́run ní ibi tí a fẹ́ fi pa wọ́n lẹ́nu mọ́. Àwọn ẹlẹ́wọ̀n yòókù gbọ́ àdúrà àti orin wọn. Ìfarahàn ayọ̀ nígbà tí ayé rọrùn nìkan kì í ṣe àmì ẹ̀mí ìṣẹ́gun; a máa ń rí i nígbà tí ìjìyà kò lè dá onígbàgbọ́ dúró láti yíjú sí Olúwa.

Ọlọ́run mì ẹ̀wọ̀n náà, Ó sì ṣí àwọn ilẹ̀kùn, ṣùgbọ́n ìtàn náà kò parí sí sísá lọ. Paulu àti Sila dúró, wọ́n sì dá olùṣọ́ ẹ̀wọ̀n náà dúró láti ṣe ara rẹ̀ léṣe. Wọ́n sọ ti Jesu fún un, àwọn ará ilé rẹ̀ sì gbọ́ ìhìnrere (Acts 16:26–34). Òmìnira wọn di àǹfààní láti dáàbò bo ẹ̀mí ẹlòmíràn àti láti jẹ́rìí. Ẹsẹ yìí kò ṣèlérí pé gbogbo ilẹ̀kùn ẹ̀wọ̀n yóò ṣí ní àkókò tí àwa bá yàn. Ṣùgbọ́n ó fi hàn pé Ọlọ́run wà pẹ̀lú wa nínú òru, àti pé àwọn ènìyàn Rẹ̀ lè fi àdúrà, ìyìn, ọgbọ́n àti àánú dáhùn.

Kí ló ti dà bí ọ̀gànjọ́ nínú ìgbésí ayé rẹ? Sọ òtítọ́ nípa ìrora náà fún Ọlọ́run. Yin Ọlọ́run fún ẹni tí Ó jẹ́, bí ohùn rẹ tilẹ̀ ń gbọ̀n, kí o sì bẹ̀ Ọlọ́run fún agbára láti ṣe ohun tó tọ́ pẹ̀lú ìṣòtítọ́ ní ibi tí o wà. Tún wo àwọn tí wọ́n ń gbọ́ tàbí tí wọ́n ń rí bí o ṣe ń dáhùn sí ipò rẹ. Bóyá ẹnìkan nílò ọ̀rọ̀ ìrètí, ìtọ́jú tí a fi ìṣe hàn, tàbí ìhìnrere fúnra rẹ̀. Olúwa lè gbé ẹ̀rí rẹ ró ní ibi líle; kò pọn dandan pé kí ìjìyà rẹ ní ọ̀rọ̀ ìkẹyìn lórí ìgbọràn rẹ.

Ṣé O Nílò Àdúrà Tàbí Ìmọ̀ràn? Bí o bá ń la àkókò ìrora tàbí àìṣòdodo kọjá, fi ìbéèrè rẹ ránṣẹ́ nípasẹ̀ Àdúrà / Ìmọ̀ràn. Fi àdírẹ́sì ímeèlì rẹ wọlé, kí ẹgbẹ́ wa lè dá ọ lóhùn, kí a sì lè máa tọ̀ ọ́ lẹ́yìn ní ìrọ̀rùn. Yóò jẹ́ ọlá fún wa láti gbàdúrà àti láti ṣe àtìlẹ́yìn fún ọ.
prayerPoints: Baba, pàdé mi ní ibi tí ìrora àti ìhámọ́ ti mú kí ìrètí ṣòro. Ní orúkọ Jesu. Àmín.
Olúwa, fọ àìnírètí tí ń sọ fún mi pé àdúrà kò wúlò ní ọ̀gànjọ́. Ní orúkọ Jesu. Àmín.
Ẹ̀mí Mímọ́, fún mi ní agbára láti jọ́sìn tọkàntọkàn, láì ṣe bí ẹni pé n kò ní ọgbẹ́. Ní orúkọ Jesu. Àmín.
Baba, dá sí ọ̀ràn náà ní ibi tí àìṣòdodo ti dẹ àwọn ènìyàn Rẹ̀ mọ́lẹ̀ tàbí tí ó ti pa wọ́n lẹ́nu mọ́. Ní orúkọ Jesu. Àmín.
Olúwa, dáàbò bò mí lọ́wọ́ ìkorò ọkàn, kí bí mo ṣe ń dáhùn sí ìjìyà má bàa ṣe àwọn ẹlòmíràn léṣe. Ní orúkọ Jesu. Àmín.
Ẹ̀mí Mímọ́, jẹ́ kí n kíyè sí ẹni tí ẹ̀mí rẹ̀ tàbí ìrètí rẹ̀ nílò ààbò lónìí. Ní orúkọ Jesu. Àmín.
Baba, jẹ́ kí sùúrù àti àánú mi ṣí ilẹ̀kùn fún ìhìnrere Kristi. Ní orúkọ Jesu. Àmín.
faithDeclarations: Olúwa gbọ́ mi ní ọ̀gànjọ́.
Mo lè gbàdúrà, kí n sì yin Ọlọ́run, láì sẹ́ pé ìrora náà jẹ́ òtítọ́.
Ìjìyà mi kò ní pinnu bóyá màá gbọ́ràn sí Kristi tàbí bóyá màá tọ́jú àwọn ẹlòmíràn.
Wíwà Ọlọ́run pẹ̀lú mi lè gbé ẹ̀rí olóòótọ́ ró ní ibikíbi tí mo bá wà.
yo.christianQuotes: “Ìṣẹ́gun ní ọ̀gànjọ́ jẹ́ ọkàn tí ń yíjú sí Ọlọ́run nígbà gbogbo, tí ó sì tún ní àyè láti tọ́jú ẹ̀mí ẹlòmíràn.” — Moses Afolabi
yo.propheticDeclaration: Kí Olúwa gbé ọ ró ní gbogbo òru tí ó dà bí ẹni pé ó gùn, tí ó sì kún fún àìṣòdodo. Mo sọ ìgboyà láti gbàdúrà, agbára láti yin Ọlọ́run, àti ọgbọ́n láti mọ àwọn tí wọ́n nílò ìtọ́jú rẹ. Kí Ọlọ́run ṣe ọ̀nà ní ibi tí o kò ti rí ọ̀nà, kí Ó sì lo ẹ̀rí ìṣòtítọ́ rẹ láti tọ́ àwọn ènìyàn sí ìrètí ìgbàlà nínú Jesu. Ní orúkọ Rẹ̀. Àmín.

source.title: Triumphant Spirit
source.scriptureText: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
source.content:
Paul and Silas had been beaten and locked in the inner prison. Their praise at midnight was not a denial of their wounds. It was an act of allegiance to God in a place meant to silence them. The other prisoners heard their prayers and songs. A triumphant spirit is not measured by a cheerful appearance when life is easy; it is seen when suffering cannot stop a believer from turning toward the Lord.

God shook the prison and opened the doors, but the story did not end with an escape. Paul and Silas remained, preventing the jailer from harming himself. They spoke to him of Jesus, and his household heard the gospel (Acts 16:26–34). Their freedom became an opportunity to protect another person's life and bear witness. This passage does not promise that every prison door will open on our timetable. It does show that God is present in the night and that His people can respond with prayer, praise, wisdom, and compassion.

What has felt like midnight to you? Tell God the truth about the pain. Praise Him for who He is, even if your voice trembles, and ask Him for the strength to act faithfully where you are. Look also at the people who hear or see your response. Perhaps someone needs a word of hope, a practical act of care, or the gospel itself. The Lord can sustain your witness in a hard place; your suffering need not have the final word over your obedience.

Need Prayer or Counseling? If you are enduring a painful or unjust season, share your request through Prayer / Counseling. Sign in with your email so our team can respond and follow up with you more easily. We would be honored to pray and offer support.
prayerPoints: Father, meet me in the place where pain and confinement have made hope difficult. In Jesus' name. Amen.
Lord, break the despair that tells me prayer is useless in the midnight hour. In Jesus' name. Amen.
Holy Spirit, give me strength to worship truthfully without pretending my wounds are absent. In Jesus' name. Amen.
Father, intervene where unjust treatment has trapped or silenced Your people. In Jesus' name. Amen.
Lord, guard me from bitterness so my response to suffering does not wound others. In Jesus' name. Amen.
Holy Spirit, make me attentive to a person whose life or hope may need protection today. In Jesus' name. Amen.
Father, let my endurance and compassion open a door for the good news of Christ. In Jesus' name. Amen.
faithDeclarations: The Lord hears me in the midnight hour.
I can pray and praise Him without denying the reality of pain.
My suffering will not decide whether I obey Christ or care for others.
God's presence can sustain a faithful witness wherever I am.
source.author: Rev. Moses Afolabi
source.christianQuotes: “Triumph at midnight is a heart that keeps turning toward God and still has room to care for another life.” — Moses Afolabi
source.propheticDeclaration: May the Lord sustain you through every night that has felt long and unjust. I speak courage to pray, strength to praise, and wisdom to recognize the people who need your care. May God make a way where you cannot see one and turn your faithful witness toward the saving hope of Jesus. In His name. Amen.
